name: Switch
description: An on/off switch; the knob slides.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 120 64" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<style>
.track{fill:#4a4f6e}.knob{fill:#fff;transform:translateX(0px)}
[data-state="on"] .track{fill:#34c759}[data-state="on"] .knob{transform:translateX(56px)}
.t{font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:#fff;opacity:.85}
</style>
<rect class="track" x="2" y="2" width="116" height="60" rx="30"/>
<circle class="knob" cx="32" cy="32" r="25"/>
</svg>
